an3.21:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati, jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an3.21:1.3: atha kho āyasmā ca saviṭṭho āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhito yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
an3.21:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ saviṭṭhaṃ āyasmā sāriputto etadavoca:
an3.21:2.1: tayome āvuso saviṭṭha, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:2.4: ime kho āvuso tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:2.5: imesaṃ kho āvuso tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ katamo te puggalo khamati abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
an3.21:3.1: tayome āvuso sāriputta, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:3.4: ime kho āvuso tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:3.5: imesaṃ āvuso tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ yvāyaṃ puggalo saddhāvimutto, ayaṃ me puggalo khamati, imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca, paṇītataro ca.
an3.21:4.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ mahākoṭṭhitaṃ etadavoca:
an3.21:4.2: tayo me āvuso koṭṭhita, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:4.5: ime kho āvuso tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:4.6: imesaṃ āvuso tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ katamo te puggalo khamati, abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
an3.21:5.1: tayome āvuso sāriputta, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:5.4: ime kho āvuso tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:5.5: imesaṃ āvuso tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ yvāyaṃ puggalo kāyasakkhī, ayaṃ me puggalo khamati, imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
an3.21:6.1: atha kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca :
an3.21:6.2: tayome āvuso sāriputta, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:6.5: ime kho āvuso tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:6.6: imesaṃ āvuso tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ katamo te puggalo khamati, abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
an3.21:7.1: tayome āvuso koṭṭhita, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:7.4: ime kho āvuso tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.21:7.5: imesaṃ āvuso tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ yvāyaṃ puggalo diṭṭhappatto, ayaṃ me puggalo khamati, imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
an3.21:8.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantañca saviṭṭhaṃ āyasmantañca mahākoṭṭhitaṃ etadavoca :
an3.21:8.2: vyākataṃ kho āvuso amhehi sabbeheva yathāsakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ.
an3.21:8.3: āyāmāvuso yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamissāma, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocessāma.
an3.21:8.4: yathā no bhagavā vyākarissati, tathā naṃ dhāressāmāti.
an3.21:8.5: evamāvusoti. kho āyasmā ca saviṭṭho āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhito āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an3.21:8.6: atha kho āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca saviṭṭho āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
an3.21:8.7: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto yāvatako ahosi āyasmatā ca saviṭṭhena āyasmatā ca mahākoṭṭhitena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
an3.21:9.1: na khottha sāriputta sukaraṃ ekaṃsena vyākātuṃ,
an3.21:9.2: ayaṃ imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
an3.21:9.3: ṭhānaṃ hetaṃ sāriputta, vijjati, yvāyaṃ puggalo saddhāvimutto svāssa arahattāya paṭipanno. yvāyaṃ puggalo kāyasakkhī, svāssa sakadāgāmī vā, anāgāmī vā. yo cāyaṃ puggalo diṭṭhappatto, sopassa sakadāgāmī vā, anāgāmī vā.
an3.21:10.1: na khottha sāriputta sukaraṃ, ekaṃsena vyākātuṃ,
an3.21:10.2: ayaṃ imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
an3.21:10.3: ṭhānaṃ hetaṃ sāriputta vijjati, yvāyaṃ puggalo kāyasakkhī svāssa arahattāya paṭipanno. yvāyaṃ puggalo saddhāvimutto, svāssa sakadāgāmī vā, anāgāmī vā, yo cāyaṃ puggalo diṭṭhappatto, so passa sakadāgāmī vā anāgāmī vā.
an3.21:11.1: na khottha sāriputta sukaraṃ ekaṃsena vyākātuṃ,
an3.21:11.2: ayaṃ imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
an3.21:11.3: ṭhānaṃ hetaṃ sāriputta, vijjati, yvāyaṃ puggalo diṭṭhappatto svāssa arahā, vā arahattāya paṭipanno, yvāyaṃ puggalo saddhāvimutto, svāssa sakadāgāmī vā, anāgāmī vā. yo cāyaṃ puggalo kāyasakkhī, sopassa. sakadāgāmī vā anāgāmī vā.
an3.21:12.1: na khottha sāriputta, sukaraṃ ekaṃsena vyākātuṃ,
an3.21:12.2: ayaṃ imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
